S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.

subtypes.Feelings of Worthlessness: A persistent perception that one is useless or inferior to others.
subtypes.Self-Criticism: Excessively and repeatedly blaming oneself for past minor failures or flaws.
subtypes.Reduced Self-Efficacy: Distrust in one's own ability to perform tasks or solve problems.
subtypes.Chronic Sense of Inferiority: Persistently evaluating oneself lower in comparison to others.
subtypes.Lack of Self-Assurance: Continually feeling anxious and unsure about decisions or actions.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.

subtypes.Future Hopelessness: The persistent conviction that the future holds no possibility of improvement.
subtypes.Belief in Impossibility of Improvement: The belief that the current situation will absolutely not get better.
subtypes.Helpless Resignation: A state of helplessness and resignation, believing that nothing will change despite effort.
subtypes.Chronic Pessimism: A persistent tendency to view everything negatively and fail to consider positive possibilities.

symptom.disease_info: Persistent Depressive Disorder is characterized by a chronically depressed mood lasting at least two years in adults, accompanied by depressive symptoms such as low energy, low self-esteem, and hopelessness, with clinically significant distress or impairment. Its course is typically steady and long-standing rather than episodic, distinguishing it from isolated major depressive episodes by its persistence and lower-grade but enduring impact on functioning.

patient.stressor_event: Spouse beginning or ceasing work outside the home
patient.stressor: Jennifer’s husband stopped working outside the home to manage a family caregiving responsibility and household logistics, a change that disrupted the quiet routines she had built around lesson planning, watercolor, gardening, and solitary decompression after school. Across the following 2 years and 2 months, she continued teaching and meeting core obligations, but a persistently low mood, fatigue, low self-regard about whether she was carrying enough for the family, and a muted sense of hope gradually narrowed her life outside the classroom. The impairment remained mild but real: she declined museum visits, stopped mentoring as actively, and found her careful STEAM planning taking far more effort than before. She raised the issue during a routine primary-care visit, and the physician referred her to psychiatry when it became clear the depressed mood and related difficulties had been continuous for more than two years.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: Most days I can still smile for my students and get through the lessons, but underneath it feels like there’s this gray, flat feeling that follows me home and makes even my garden or watercolors seem far away.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.
S029.manifestation: I came in because I’m tired all the time, not the normal teacher-at-the-end-of-the-day tired, but like even after a full night’s sleep I have to push myself through grading, dinner, and getting ready for the next morning.

S042.name: Low_Self_Esteem
S042.description: A persistent tendency to evaluate oneself as incompetent or worthless; chronically low self-evaluation.
S042.manifestation: I keep thinking I should be handling everything better, and when my lesson plans take twice as long or I say no to mentoring a newer teacher, I tell myself I’m letting my family and my school down.

S083.name: Hopelessness
S083.description: A feeling of despair or having no hope for the future.
S083.manifestation: I don’t feel like things are falling apart, exactly, but I have a hard time believing I’m going to feel lighter or get back to being the person who looked forward to museums, projects, and quiet afternoons.

add_requirements.functional_impairment: I’m still showing up for my students and my family, but I’ve pulled back from mentoring, social outings, and the creative routines that used to keep my life feeling full.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about two years and two months, since my husband stopped working outside the home and our household routine changed.
